### Jesus Brings Division
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jesus-brings-division
Passage: John 7:40-46
Points:
- Jesus' offer of living water prompted some listeners to view Him as the promised prophet like Moses.
- Others identified Him as the Messiah, while skeptics wrongly assumed His Galilean upbringing disqualified Him from being David's heir from Bethlehem.
- The crowd became sharply divided over His identity, with some desiring to arrest Him while officers hesitated.
- Confrontation with the claims of Jesus leaves no middle ground; hearers must either receive Him or reject Him.
- Christians must present Christ as Scripture reveals Him rather than reshape Him to avoid controversy.
